title: feat(nscoex): same-tick y existential opposite: reverse fail, face fail
science: Existential-opposite on same-tick-inclusive y-probe lock sets: S(A)={+e_1}, S(B)={+e_1,+e_3}, S(C)=S(D)={+e_2} -> reverse FAIL, face FAIL. The runner's `x-probe-strictly-earlier-face-hold-is-not-this-display` records that the identical predicate on the x-probes gives face HOLD (#7081), so face swings hold/fail on probe frame alone under a fixed readout.
